item.title: Aidoku v0.9
item.description:
Aidoku 0.9 | Aidoku
- OCR dictionary support (iOS 18+): import Yomitan-compatible dictionaries in the app and look up words while reading. - Suwayomi built-in source: read and track from a Suwayomi instance, just like Komga and Kavita. - Auto scroll for webtoon reader: enable and press the play button to scroll without touching your device. - Fixed CloudFlare handling: CloudFlare issues that caused external sources to break should be resolved. - Overall performance improvements: the library loads much faster (@Amqx), and the webtoon reader was improved. - Source stability fixes and disable option: the issue where sources were causing the app to crash should not happen again, and now you can even disable a source that is broken until it receives an update. - Many more things: see [the website](https://aidoku.app/release-notes/) for a more complete list.
